question_mn: 2026 оны 3-р сард ерөнхий дэвтэрт бүртгэсэн хүүгийн орлого хэд вэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 3-r sard yerunhii dewtert bvrtgesen hvvgiin orlogo hed we?
question_en: How much interest income was recorded in the general ledger in March 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'

question_mn: Энэ оны эхнээс хойш нийт хэдэн төгрөгийн шимтгэлийн орлого бүртгэгдсэн бэ?
question_latin: Ene onii ekhnees khoish niit kheden togrogiin shimtgeliin orlogo burtgegdsen be?
question_en: How much fee income has been recorded since the beginning of this year?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS fee_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4200' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Өнгөрсөн жил торгуулийн орлого хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: Ungursun jil torguuliin orlogo hed baisan be
question_en: What was penalty income last year?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS penalty_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4300' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND fiscal_year = 2025

question_mn: 2025 онд хадгаламжийн хүүгийн зардал нийт хэд гарсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond khadgalamjiin khuugiin zardal niit khed garsan be?
question_en: What was the total deposit interest expense in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5100' AND dr_cr = 'D' AND fiscal_year = 2025

question_mn: 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцсийн агшинд 90-ээс дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээл хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 6-r sariin etssiin agshind 90-ees deesh honog hetersen zeel hed baisan be?
question_en: How many loans were more than 90 days past due in the June 2026 month-end snapshot?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date = DATE '2026-06-30' AND days_past_due > 90

question_mn: Энэ онд илэрсэн AML сэрэмжлүүлгүүдээс хэдийг нь СЭГТ-д мэдээлсэн бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond ilersen AML seremjluulguudees khediig ni SEGT-d medeelsen be?
question_en: Of the AML alerts detected this year, how many were reported to the FIU as suspicious transactions?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS reported_alerts FROM t2s.aml_alerts WHERE str_reported AND detected_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Жил бүрийн цэвэр хүүгийн орлогыг гарга.
question_latin: Jil bvriin tsewer hvvgiin orlogiig garga.
question_en: Show net interest income for each year.
question_mixed: Жил бүрийн NII (net interest income)-ийг гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C' THEN amount_mnt WHEN account_code = '5100' AND dr_cr = 'D' THEN -amount_mnt ELSE 0 END) AS net_interest_income FROM t2s.gl_entries GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрийн эрсдэлийн сангийн цэвэр зардлыг (дебитээс буцаалтыг хассан) гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bvriin ersdeliin sangiin tsewer zardliig (debitees butsaaltiig hassan) garga.
question_en: Show the net loan-loss provision expense (debits minus reversals) for each quarter of 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM posting_date)::int AS quarter, SUM(CASE WHEN dr_cr = 'D' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS provision_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5200' AND fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2024 оноос хойшхи улирал бүрийн шимтгэлийн орлогыг улирлаар нь гарга.
question_latin: 2024 onoos hoishhi uliral bvriin shimtgeliin orlogiig ulirlaar ni garga.
question_en: Show fee income for every quarter since 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM posting_date)::int || '-Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM posting_date)::int AS quarter, SUM(amount_mnt) AS fee_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4200' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2026 оны эхний хагаст шимтгэлийн орлого хамгийн их бүртгэсэн 5 салбарын нэр, дүнг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii ekhnii khagast shimtgeliin orlogo khamgiin ikh burtgesen 5 salbariin ner, dung garga.
question_en: List the 5 branches with the highest fee income recorded in the first half of 2026, with the amounts.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(g.amount_mnt) AS fee_income FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE g.account_code = '4200' AND g.dr_cr = 'C' AND g.posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name ORDER BY fee_income DESC, b.branch_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: 2025 оны эцсийн байдлаар ерөнхий дэвтрийн зээлийн данснуудын (хэвийн ба чанаргүй зээл) үлдэгдэл хэд байсан бэ?
question_latin: 2025 onii etssiin baidlaar yerunhii dewtriin zeeliin dansnuudiin (hewiin ba chanargvi zeel) vldegdel hed baisan be?
question_en: What was the general-ledger balance of the loan accounts (performing and non-performing loans) as of the end of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dr_cr = 'D' THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) AS loan_balance FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code IN ('1210', '1230') AND posting_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
notes: Активын дансны үлдэгдэл = эхнээс нь тухайн огноо хүртэлх дебит − кредит.

question_mn: Хаагдсан AML сэрэмжлүүлгүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь хуурамч дохио болж хаагдсаныг дүрэм бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Khaagdsan AML seremjluulguudiin kheden khuvi ni khuuramch dokhio bolj khaagdsaniig durem bureer garga.
question_en: Among closed AML alerts, what percentage were closed as false positives, by rule?
gold_sql: SELECT rule_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE', 'CLOSED_REPORTED')), 0), 2) AS false_positive_pct FROM t2s.aml_alerts GROUP BY rule_name

question_mn: Хаагдсан AML сэрэмжлүүлгүүдийг ноцтой байдлын түвшин бүрээр нь илэрснээс хаагдах хүртэл дунджаар хэдэн хоног зарцуулсныг гарга.
question_latin: Haagdsan AML seremjlvvlgvvdiig notstoi baidliin tvwshin bvreer ni ilersnees haagdah hvrtel dundjaar heden honog zartsuulsniig garga.
question_en: For closed AML alerts, show the average number of days from detection to closure by severity level.
gold_sql: SELECT severity, ROUND(AVG(closed_date - detected_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_close FROM t2s.aml_alerts WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY severity

question_mn: 2025 оноос хойш улирал бүрт хэдэн AML сэрэмжлүүлэг илэрч, үүнээс хэд нь СЭГТ-д мэдээлэгдсэнийг гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onoos hoish uliral bvrt heden AML seremjlvvleg ilerch, vvnees hed ni SEGT-d medeelegdseniig garga.
question_en: Since 2025, for each quarter, how many AML alerts were detected and how many of them were reported to the FIU?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM detected_date)::int || '-Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM detected_date)::int AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS alerts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE str_reported) AS reported FROM t2s.aml_alerts WHERE detected_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2025 оны жилийн эцсийн агшинд активын ангилал бүрээр зээлийн тоо, нийт үлдэгдлийг гарга. Ам.долларын зээлийг тухайн өдрийн ханшаар төгрөгт шилжүүл.
question_latin: 2025 onii jiliin etssiin agshind aktiwiin angilal bvreer zeeliin too, niit vldegdliig garga. Am.dollariin zeeliig tuhain udriin hanshaar tugrugt shiljvvl.
question_en: In the year-end 2025 snapshot, show the number of loans and total outstanding by asset classification, converting USD loans to MNT at that day's rate.
gold_sql: SELECT h.classification_code, COUNT(*) AS loans, ROUND(SUM(h.total_outstanding * t2s.fx_to_mnt(l.currency_code, h.snapshot_date)), 2) AS outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY h.classification_code
notes: Сарын эцсийн агшны үлдэгдэл зээлийн валютаар — валютыг loans-оос авч, агшны өдрийн ханшаар хөрвүүлнэ.

question_mn: 2025 оны сар бүрийн эцсийн агшинд бүх зээлийн хэдэн хувь нь эргэлзээтэй эсвэл муу ангилалтай байсныг (тоогоор) гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii sar buriin etssiin agshind bukh zeeliin kheden khuvi ni ergelzeetei esvel muu angilaltai baisniig (toogoor) garga.
question_en: For each month-end snapshot in 2025, what percentage of loans (by count) were classified as doubtful or loss?
gold_sql: SELECT snapshot_date, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE classification_code IN ('DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS npl_count_pct FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date

question_mn: Эрсдэлийн сангийн цэвэр зардал хүүгийн орлогын хэдэн хувьтай тэнцэж байсныг жил бүрээр гарга.
question_latin: Ersdeliin sangiin tsewer zardal hvvgiin orlogiin heden huwitai tentsej baisniig jil bvreer garga.
question_en: For each year, show net provision expense as a percentage of interest income.
gold_sql: SELECT fiscal_year, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = '5200' AND dr_cr = 'D' THEN amount_mnt WHEN account_code = '5200' AND dr_cr = 'C' THEN -amount_mnt ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C'), 0), 2) AS provision_to_interest_pct FROM t2s.gl_entries GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

question_mn: 2025 онд үйл ажиллагааны зардал хамгийн их гарсан сар аль вэ? Тайлант үе, дүнг хэл.
question_latin: 2025 ond uil ajillagaanii zardal khamgiin ikh garsan sar ali ve? Tailant ue, dung khel.
question_en: Which month of 2025 had the highest operating expense? Give the accounting period and the amount.
gold_sql: SELECT period_code, SUM(amount_mnt) AS operating_expense FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '5400' AND dr_cr = 'D' AND fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY period_code ORDER BY operating_expense DESC, period_code LIMIT 1

question_mn: Орон нутгийн салбар тус бүрийн 2026 оны эхний хагасын хүүгийн орлогыг (ерөнхий дэвтрээр) гарга.
question_latin: Oron nutgiin salbar tus bvriin 2026 onii ehnii hagasiin hvvgiin orlogiig (yerunhii dewtreer) garga.
question_en: Show the general-ledger interest income for the first half of 2026 for each branch outside Ulaanbaatar.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(g.amount_mnt) AS interest_income FROM t2s.gl_entries g JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = g.branch_id WHERE b.province <> 'Улаанбаатар' AND g.account_code = '4100' AND g.dr_cr = 'C' AND g.posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 2-р улиралд журнал бүрт хэдэн бичилт хийгдсэнийг (бичилтийн давхардаагүй дугаараар) журналын нэрээр гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii 2-r ulirald jurnal bvrt heden bichilt hiigdseniig (bichiltiin dawhardaagvi dugaaraar) jurnaliin nereer garga.
question_en: In Q2 2026, how many journal entries (distinct entry numbers) were posted in each journal? Show the journal name.
gold_sql: SELECT journal_name, COUNT(DISTINCT entry_no) AS entries FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY journal_name

question_mn: 2026 оны эхний хагаст ам.доллароор бүртгэгдсэн ерөнхий дэвтрийн мөрүүдийн нийт дүнг доллараар болон төгрөгөөр гаргаж, тэдгээрийн жигнэсэн дундаж ханшийг тооцоол.
question_latin: 2026 onii ehnii hagast am.dollaroor bvrtgegdsen yerunhii dewtriin murvvdiin niit dvng dollaraar bolon tugruguur gargaj, tedgeeriin jignesen dundaj hanshiig tootsool.
question_en: For GL lines booked in USD in the first half of 2026, show the total in USD and in MNT and the implied weighted average exchange rate.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount_usd, SUM(amount_mnt) AS amount_mnt, ROUND(SUM(amount_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0), 2) AS avg_rate FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE currency_code = 'USD' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрийн хүүгийн орлого өмнөх сараасаа хэдэн хувиар өссөнийг гарга. 1-р сарыг 2025 оны 12-р сартай харьцуулна.
question_latin: 2026 onii sar buriin khuugiin orlogo omnokh saraasaa kheden khuviar ossoniig garga. 1-r sariig 2025 onii 12-r sartai kharitsuulna.
question_en: Show how much monthly interest income grew versus the previous month for each month of 2026 (January compared with December 2025).
question_mixed: 2026 оны interest income-ийн month-over-month growth-ийг хувиар гарга (1-р сарыг 2025 оны 12-р сартай).
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', posting_date)::date AS month, SUM(amount_mnt) AS interest_income FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C' AND posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), w AS (SELECT month, interest_income, LAG(interest_income) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_income FROM m) SELECT month, interest_income, ROUND(100.0 * (interest_income - prev_income) / NULLIF(prev_income, 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM w WHERE month >= DATE '2026-01-01' ORDER BY month

question_mn: Орлого, зардлын данс бүрээр 2025 оны эхний хагас болон 2026 оны эхний хагасын дүнг харьцуулж, өөрчлөлтийн хувийг дансны нэртэй нь гарга (орлого = кредит − дебит, зардал = дебит − кредит).
question_latin: Orlogo, zardliin dans bvreer 2025 onii ehnii hagas bolon 2026 onii ehnii hagasiin dvng haritsuulj, uurchlultiin huwiig dansnii nertei ni garga (orlogo = kredit − debit, zardal = debit − kredit).
question_en: For every income and expense account, compare H1 2025 with H1 2026 and show the percentage change, with the account name (income = credit − debit, expense = debit − credit).
gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT account_code, account_name_mn, SUM(CASE WHEN (account_type = 'INCOME' AND dr_cr = 'C') OR (account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND dr_cr = 'D') THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) FILTER (WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30') AS h1_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN (account_type = 'INCOME' AND dr_cr = 'C') OR (account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND dr_cr = 'D') THEN amount_mnt ELSE -amount_mnt END) FILTER (WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') AS h1_2026 FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE account_type IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE') GROUP BY account_code, account_name_mn) SELECT account_name_mn, h1_2025, h1_2026, ROUND(100.0 * (h1_2026 - h1_2025) / NULLIF(h1_2025, 0), 2) AS change_pct FROM a

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрийн цэвэр хүүгийн орлого болон оны эхнээс хуримтлагдсан дүнг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sar buriin tsever khuugiin orlogo bolon onii ekhnees khurimtlagdsan dung garga.
question_en: Show monthly net interest income for 2026 together with the year-to-date cumulative amount.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', posting_date)::date AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = '4100' AND dr_cr = 'C' THEN amount_mnt WHEN account_code = '5100' AND dr_cr = 'D' THEN -amount_mnt ELSE 0 END) AS nii FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE posting_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, nii, SUM(nii) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS ytd_nii FROM m ORDER BY month

question_mn: 2026 оны сар бүрээр өмнөх сарын эцэст 1–30 хоног хэтэрсэн байсан зээлүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь тухайн сарын эцэст 30-аас дээш хоног хэтэрсэн бүлэг рүү шилжсэнийг гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii sar bvreer umnuh sariin etsest 1–30 honog hetersen baisan zeelvvdiin heden huwi ni tuhain sariin etsest 30-aas deesh honog hetersen bvleg rvv shiljseniig garga.
question_en: For each month of 2026, what percentage of loans that were 1–30 days past due at the previous month-end had rolled to more than 30 days past due at that month-end?
question_mixed: 2026 оны сар бүрийн 1–30 bucket-аас 30+ рүү шилжсэн roll rate-ийг гарга.
gold_sql: SELECT b.snapshot_date AS month_end, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.days_past_due > 30) / COUNT(*), 2) AS roll_rate_pct FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history b ON b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = (date_trunc('month', a.snapshot_date) + interval '2 month - 1 day')::date WHERE a.dpd_bucket = 'DPD_1_30' AND b.snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY b.snapshot_date ORDER BY b.snapshot_date

question_mn: 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцэс ба 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцсийн агшинд хоёуланд нь байгаа зээлүүдээс ангилал нь өөрчлөгдсөнийг хуучин, шинэ ангиллаар нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii 12-r sariin etses ba 2026 onii 6-r sariin etssiin agshind khoyouland ni baigaa zeeluudees angilal ni oorchlogdsoniig khuuchin, shine angillaar ni toolj garga.
question_en: Among loans present in both the December 2025 and June 2026 month-end snapshots, count those whose classification changed, by old and new classification.
gold_sql: SELECT a.classification_code AS from_class, b.classification_code AS to_class, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history b ON b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-06-30' WHERE a.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31' AND a.classification_code <> b.classification_code GROUP BY 1, 2

question_mn: 2026 оны эхний хагаст сар бүр анх удаа 90-ээс дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээл хэд байсныг сарын эцсийн агшнаар гарга.
question_latin: 2026 onii ehnii hagast sar bvr anh udaa 90-ees deesh honog hetersen zeel hed baisniig sariin etssiin agshnaar garga.
question_en: For each month-end in the first half of 2026, how many loans became more than 90 days past due for the first time?
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT loan_id, MIN(snapshot_date) AS first_90_date FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history WHERE days_past_due > 90 GROUP BY loan_id) SELECT first_90_date AS month_end, COUNT(*) AS new_90_plus_loans FROM f WHERE first_90_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY first_90_date ORDER BY first_90_date

question_mn: 2025 оны улирал бүрээр үйл ажиллагааны зардал нь цэвэр хүүгийн орлого, шимтгэл ба торгуулийн орлогын нийлбэрийн хэдэн хувьтай тэнцэж байсныг гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii uliral bureer uil ajillagaanii zardal ni tsever khuugiin orlogo, shimtgel ba torguuliin orlogiin niilberiin kheden khuvitai tentsej baisniig garga.
question_en: For each quarter of 2025, show operating expense as a percentage of net interest income plus fee and penalty income (cost-to-income ratio).
question_mixed: 2025 оны улирал бүрийн cost-to-income ratio-г гарга (opex / (NII + fee + penalty income)).
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM posting_date)::int AS quarter, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE account_code = '5400' AND dr_cr = 'D') / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN account_code IN ('4100', '4200', '4300') AND dr_cr = 'C' THEN amount_mnt WHEN account_code = '5100' AND dr_cr = 'D' THEN -amount_mnt ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS cost_to_income_pct FROM t2s.gl_entries WHERE fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцэс болон 2026 оны 6-р сарын эцсийн агшинд 30-аас дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээлийн тоог салбар бүрээр зэрэгцүүлж, хэдээр өөрчлөгдсөнийг гарга.
question_latin: 2025 onii 12-r sariin etses bolon 2026 onii 6-r sariin etssiin agshind 30-aas deesh honog hetersen zeeliin toog salbar bvreer zeregtsvvlj, hedeer uurchlugdsuniig garga.
question_en: By branch, compare the number of loans more than 30 days past due in the December 2025 and June 2026 month-end snapshots and show the change.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31') AS dec_2025, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-06-30') AS jun_2026, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-06-30') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.snapshot_date = DATE '2025-12-31') AS change FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE h.snapshot_date IN (DATE '2025-12-31', DATE '2026-06-30') AND h.days_past_due > 30 GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: 2026 оны сарын эцсийн агшин бүрээр 30-аас дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээлийн нийт үлдэгдэл бүх зээлийн нийт үлдэгдлийн хэдэн хувь байсныг гарга. Ам.долларын зээлийг тухайн агшны өдрийн ханшаар төгрөгт шилжүүл.
question_latin: 2026 onii sariin etssiin agshin bureer 30-aas deesh khonog khetersen zeeliin niit uldegdel bukh zeeliin niit uldegdliin kheden khuvi baisniig garga. Am.dollariin zeeliig tukhain agshnii odriin khanshaar togrogt shiljuul.
question_en: For each 2026 month-end snapshot, what percentage of total outstanding was on loans more than 30 days past due? Convert USD loans to MNT at the snapshot-date rate.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT h.snapshot_date, h.days_past_due, h.total_outstanding * t2s.fx_to_mnt(l.currency_code, h.snapshot_date) AS outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE h.snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') SELECT snapshot_date, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS over_30_share_pct FROM s GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date
notes: loan_dpd_history-д үндсэн үлдэгдэл байхгүй тул нийт үлдэгдлээр тооцно (каноник PAR30 нь loans-ийн үндсэн үлдэгдлээр).

question_mn: 2026 оны 3-р сарын эцэст 1–30 хоног хэтэрсэн байсан зээлүүдийн хэдэн хувь нь 4-р сарын эцэст хугацаа хэтрэлтгүй болж засарсан бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii 3-r sariin etsest 1–30 honog hetersen baisan zeelvvdiin heden huwi ni 4-r sariin etsest hugatsaa hetreltgvi bolj zasarsan be?
question_en: Of the loans that were 1–30 days past due at the end of March 2026, what percentage were current (no days past due) at the end of April 2026?
question_mixed: 2026 оны 3-р сарын эцсийн 1–30 bucket-ийн зээлүүдийн cure rate (4-р сарын эцэст current болсон хувь) хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.dpd_bucket = 'CURRENT') / COUNT(*), 2) AS cure_rate_pct FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history b ON b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-04-30' WHERE a.snapshot_date = DATE '2026-03-31' AND a.dpd_bucket = 'DPD_1_30'
